title: Nonsmooth Obstacles and Killed Resolvents in Reflected Stochastic Control
summary: We study an infinite-horizon optimal stopping problem for a normally reflected two-dimensional diffusion in the quadrant with nonsmooth max-type payoff \(G(x_1,x_2)=x_1\veeαx_2\). The main novelty is a measure-valued variational formulation: the stopping gain \(Γ=c+rG-\mathcal LG\) is shown to be a signed Radon measure whose singular component is supported on the kink diagonal \(\{x_1=αx_2\}\), and this component is computed explicitly.
